tools.description: Get a webhook by id.

tools.name: create_webhook
tools.description: Create a project webhook fired on eventType. Defaults: Post, enabled, TestIT JSON body. Passing customBody sends it instead of the default body.

shouldSendBody.description: Send TestIT's default JSON body (default true).

customBody.description: Custom body; may contain variables from list_webhook_variables.

tools.name: set_webhook
tools.description: Change some fields of a webhook (e.g. isEnabled=false to pause it); other fields are kept.

shouldSendBody.description: Send TestIT's default JSON body (default true).

customBody.description: Custom body; may contain variables from list_webhook_variables.

tools.name: delete_webhook
tools.description: Delete a webhook permanently.

tools.name: list_webhook_variables
tools.description: Variables ($TEST_PLAN_NAME, ...) available for an event type, for url or body templates.

tools.name: submit_webhook_test
tools.description: Send a test request from TestIT to a URL and return the HTTP response it got.

tools.name: list_webhook_logs
tools.description: Recent webhook calls of a project (request, response, status).

take.description: Max number of items to return.

page.description: 1-based page number; alternative to skip. Uses "size" (default 50).

size.description: Page size for "page"; alias of take.

searchValue.description: Value to search for in searchField.

tools.name: list_workflows
tools.description: Workflows (sets of test statuses) with the projects using them. Read-only here: creating workflows needs the custom statuses feature of the TestIT plan.

tools.name: get_workflow
tools.description: A workflow with its statuses (code, type, priority).

tools.name: list_workflow_projects
tools.description: Projects that use a workflow.

tools.name: search_notifications
tools.description: Notifications of the current user (mentions, assigned test points, ...).

take.description: Max number of items to return.

page.description: 1-based page number; alternative to skip. Uses "size" (default 50).

size.description: Page size for "page"; alias of take.

searchValue.description: Value to search for in searchField.

tools.name: get_notifications_count
tools.description: Number of notifications of the current user in the last 7 days (optionally only unread).

tools.name: set_notifications_read
tools.description: Mark one notification (id) or, without id, ALL notifications of the current user as read.

id.description: Notification UUID; omit to mark all.

tools.name: get_project_autotest_settings
tools.description: Autotest settings of a project: reruns, flaky detection, run retention, work item updating.

tools.name: set_project_autotest_settings
tools.description: Change some autotest settings of a project; others are kept. Some (reruns, flaky thresholds) need a paid TestIT feature and fail with 402 otherwise.

workItemUpdatingEnabled.description: Update linked work items from autotest results.
